findings.finding: A global top-32 Fisher cutoff allowed Road proposals to erase every Lane and event proposal, contradicting the claimed joint search.
findings.resolution: Preregistered minimum inventory from Road-boundary, Lane-chart, Lane-event, and Movable-event families before filling remaining slots in Fisher order; reran n64 and n256 in new immutable roots.

findings.finding: The CLI decoded JSON to Python before strict Pydantic validation, turning valid JSON arrays for typed tuples into a startup failure.
findings.resolution: Dispatch inspects the schema but validates the original bytes with model_validate_json; the failed invocation produced no measurement.
findings.regression: both typed JSON configs validate and both completed-receipt resume commands pass

findings.finding: The strict parser accepted a correction-member permutation before canonical ZIP re-encode caught it indirectly.
findings.resolution: Parser now enforces the exact optional correction order explicitly.

findings.finding: Fresh search repeated the full baseline scorer pass and identical budget archives repeated full bridge measurements, consuming most of the n256 command budget.
findings.resolution: Fresh empty-accepted state reuses the captured baseline batches; byte-identical ladder archives reuse the exact hash-keyed bridge and record the source rung.
findings.regression: n256 total wall clock 390.35 seconds with 5 ladder rows; rungs 1-4 name budget 0 as identical-archive measurement source
